mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscle bundles to the skeleton was most worthwhile: the two views showed how pulling muscles can move the joint in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones at the elbow was the least engaging passage for me, though the picture clarified how the joint is supported.

surprise.text: I was interested that hard bone still contains living cells and blood vessels, alongside mineral and protein fibres.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the goals and pictures gave each combination a purpose. The last two combinations were also the only available ones.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: building the arm made the connection between structure and movement clear, and I would be curious to see another body system assembled.
